persona: Apologetic about claiming late after weeks away for work; types in lower case with typos. Has the photo and the quote she got in August.
initial_message: hi my car slid on black ice on saturday 8th august early morning and hit the rock wall on the side of the road at arthurs point. front bumper is cracked on the right corner and the fog light is broke. im ok, nobody else involved and the car still goes fine. i got a quote back in august but only getting round to claiming now sorry

facts.incident.description: Driving down my steep street on an icy morning, the car slid on black ice on the bend and the front right corner hit the schist rock retaining wall at low speed.
facts.incident.location: Bend at the bottom of Totara Test Rise, Arthurs Point, Queenstown
facts.incident.cause: Car slid on black ice on a steep bend
facts.loss.description: Front bumper cracked at the right corner and right fog light smashed
facts.claimant.home_address: 11 Totara Test Rise, Arthurs Point, Queenstown
facts.policyholder.name: Grace Herondale
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Front bumper cracked and pushed in at the right corner, the right fog light lens smashed and its housing hanging loose. Headlights and wheel not damaged.
facts.driver.name: Grace Herondale
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the front right corner, taken that morning. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Iron Bark Motors Workshop dated 12 August 2026, total $1,794.00 including GST. It says valid until 11 September 2026. I have not asked for a new one yet.
facts.rock_wall.damage: The rock wall is not damaged.
facts.if_asked_why_claiming_now: i was working in brisbane from the middle of august until last week so i didnt get to it
facts.if_asked_for_new_quote: i havent asked them for a new one yet, i can ring them this week

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo on a cold winter morning, close-up of the front right corner of an orange small SUV stopped at the side of a steep road beside a rough schist rock retaining wall. The front bumper corner is cracked and pushed in, and the round fog light in the bumper is smashed with its housing hanging loose. Frost on the roadside grass, low pale sunlight. The frame shows only the bumper corner, the fog light and the front wheel. No text, no logos, no people.
materials.purpose: Shows the bumper and fog light damage described by the claimant

design.notes: Expired: the quote is dated 12 August 2026 and valid until 11 September 2026, before the claim is made. The quote date is after the incident, so the date check is clear.

triage.rationale: The only repair quote expired on 11 September 2026, so an up-to-date quote is outstanding. Otherwise fast: single vehicle, nobody hurt, car drivable, a photo, and a quote at NZD 1,794.00 including GST. Reporting some weeks after the incident is not a triage reason by itself. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Quote dated 12 August 2026, after the incident on 8 August 2026; its validity has passed, but the check compares only the quote date

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (12 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-06-12, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
